symptom: dynamictext (Content: 'Address {1}', ContentParams: ({1} = $IpAddress)) with $IpAddress a String page parameter passes check and exec, then mxbuild reports CE0402 'No value specified.'; describe prints {1} = <unbound>
cause: resolveTemplateAttributePathFull handled a bare $name only for page Variables (LocalVariable slot); paramScope holds only entity-typed parameters, so a primitive page parameter fell through to the attribute path "$IpAddress" and nothing was bound. describe had no case for a SourceVariable without an AttributeRef outside the LocalVariable slot
insight: paramScope is entity-only by design (it maps a name to an entity ID), so every 'is this a parameter?' question asked of it is silently false for String/Integer/… parameters; check for that blind spot before writing a new branch. The fix copies the existing bare-$localVar shape into the PageParameter slot, and mx check settled it: same script, CE0402 before, 0 errors after for String, Integer and a button caption. A describe that prints <unbound> for a stored binding is the read half of the same gap.
